properties.name: Aurora Borealis Main Oval
properties.desc: Primary auroral oval belt centered around Earth's geomagnetic pole (~80.5°N, 72.6°W). Energetic solar wind particles channeled along geomagnetic lines ignite shimmering emerald and violet curtains.
properties.label: AURORA BOREALIS OVAL (67°N Geomagnetic)

properties.name: Aurora Australis Main Oval
properties.desc: Circumpolar Southern Lights belt visible from Antarctica, southern New Zealand (Stewart Island), and Tasmania during solar storms.
properties.label: AURORA AUSTRALIS OVAL (67°S Geomagnetic)

properties.name: Tromsø
properties.desc: Historic Tromsø Geophysical Observatory under the auroral oval peak in Scandinavian Lapland.

properties.name: Fairbanks
properties.desc: Home to the Poker Flat Research Range rocket facility and Geophysical Institute at UAF.

properties.name: Reykjavik
properties.desc: Thingvellir National Park dark sky zone situated on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge rift valley.

properties.name: Yellowknife
properties.desc: World-famous Aurora Village on Great Slave Lake with crystal-clear subarctic skies.

properties.name: Rovaniemi
properties.desc: Official Arctic Circle gateway in Finnish Lapland with pristine subpolar night viewing.

properties.name: Abisko
properties.desc: Aurora Sky Station in Abisko National Park, famous for the microclimatic 'Blue Hole' cloud clearing.

properties.name: Svalbard (Kjell Henriksen Obs)
properties.desc: World premier polar cusp observatory capable of observing mid-day auroras during the 24-hour Polar Night.

properties.name: Kiruna Geophysical Institute
properties.desc: Swedish Institute of Space Physics (IRF) and Esrange Space Center sounding rocket range.

properties.name: Whitehorse
properties.desc: Yukon wilderness viewing base surrounded by high boreal mountains with minimal light pollution.

properties.name: Churchill (Northern Studies Centre)
properties.desc: Subarctic geomagnetic research center on Hudson Bay beneath the southern dip of the auroral oval.

properties.name: Iqaluit
properties.desc: High Arctic capital on Baffin Island situated directly under magnetic field lines channeling solar wind.

properties.name: Alta
properties.desc: Site of the world's first dedicated Northern Lights observatory built atop Mount Haldde in 1899.

properties.name: Sodankylä Geophysical Observatory
properties.desc: University of Oulu research station monitoring geomagnetic variations, ionospheric radar, and auroral pulsations.

properties.name: Ilulissat
properties.desc: Disko Bay Arctic icefjord dark sky site with spectacular auroras shimmering over colossal tabular icebergs.

properties.name: Kangerlussuaq
properties.desc: Former Sondrestrom Upper Atmospheric Incoherent Scatter Radar facility on the Greenland ice sheet border.

properties.name: Murmansk
properties.desc: Kola Peninsula subpolar base with the Polar Geophysical Institute studying magnetospheric storms.

properties.name: Norilsk
properties.desc: Taimyr Peninsula station in northern Siberia situated right on the northern auroral belt.

properties.name: Tiksi Polar Observatory
properties.desc: Arctic Laptev Sea geomag observatory investigating cosmic rays and polar auroral substorms.

properties.name: Anchorage
properties.desc: Chugach State Park scenic overlook frequently illuminated by auroral curtains during moderate solar storms.

properties.name: Banff Dark Sky Preserve
properties.desc: Canadian Rocky Mountain preserve where geomagnetic G1+ storms trigger vivid displays over Lake Minnewanka.

properties.name: Stewart Island (Rakiura)
properties.desc: Certified International Dark Sky Sanctuary ('Glowing Skies' in Māori) capturing vibrant southern auroras.

properties.name: Hobart (Mount Wellington)
properties.desc: Elevated southern vantage point overlooking the Southern Ocean, prime for Aurora Australis during coronal mass ejections.

properties.name: Ushuaia
properties.desc: Southernmost city in the world on the Beagle Channel in Tierra del Fuego, facing the Antarctic auroral belt.

properties.name: Syowa Station
properties.desc: National Institute of Polar Research Antarctic base equipped with all-sky auroral cameras and auroral radar.

properties.name: Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station
properties.desc: Atmospheric research observatory at 2,835m altitude directly beneath the South Polar cusp and continuous winter aurora.
